meta.title: Riad Berber Towers · Riad and guesthouse in Imlil, at the foot of Toubkal
meta.description: Family riad in the centre of Imlil with 7 hand-built rooms, steps from the Toubkal trail. Breakfast included, Moroccan dinner and guided hikes.

brand.descriptor: Made by hand in the heart of Imlil.

home.title: Seven rooms. One valley. Made by hand.
home.comingSoon: Our new website is being built.

hero.lead: A family guesthouse of carved wood, tadelakt and Fes zellij in the centre of Imlil, at the foot of Toubkal. Breakfast on the roof is included.
hero.alt: Riad Berber Towers, an ochre tower house among the walnut trees of Imlil
hero.caption: Imlil · Al Haouz
hero.fromPrice: Rooms from {price} a night, breakfast included

intro.label: The house
intro.text: Riad Berber Towers rises three floors above the village, built with the craft of the High Atlas: tadelakt walls, zellij floors, wooden ceilings carved by hand. The trail to Toubkal starts at our door.

climb.label: Climb the house
climb.title: Three floors and a roof
climb.text: From the fountain to the terrace, every floor has its own rooms and its own view.

ground.label: Ground floor
ground.title: The fountain floor
ground.text: Reception, the salon around the zellij fountain, and two rooms that open onto the garden and the village.

first.label: First floor
first.title: The wooden gallery
first.text: Four suites around the open atrium, under carved wooden beams. Three of them look out to the mountains.

second.label: Second floor
second.title: Under the skylight
second.text: One suite on its own, closest to the stained-glass skylight, with a balcony facing the mountains.

roof.label: Roof terrace
roof.title: The terrace
roof.text: Breakfast in the morning sun with the Toubkal ridges in front of you. At night, the village lights and the stars.

tea.label: The welcome
tea.title: It starts with mint tea
tea.text1: Every arrival begins in the salon by the fountain, with mint tea poured from high, the way it is done in every Berber house in the valley.
tea.text2: After that, the house is yours: warm floors after a day on the trail, a quiet room, and breakfast on the roof the next morning.
tea.alt1: Mint tea being poured in the salon of Riad Berber Towers
tea.alt2: A silver teapot and glasses with fresh mint on a tray

strip.label: Inside
strip.title: Wood, zellij and light
strip.text: Everything in the house was made by craftsmen from the region, from the carved doors to the coloured glass.

salon.title: The salon
salon.text: Low benches, Berber cushions and wooden tables.

gallery.title: The gallery
gallery.text: Wrought-iron balustrades and wooden doors around the atrium.

skylight.title: The skylight
skylight.text: Coloured glass that sends light down through three floors.

stairs.title: The staircase
stairs.text: Turned wood and Berber carpet, from the entrance up.

fountain.title: From above
fountain.text: The zellij fountain, seen from the top of the atrium.

imlil.label: Imlil
imlil.title: A village at the foot of Toubkal
imlil.text: Walnut trees, terraced fields and mule paths. From here you walk to the waterfalls, to the villages of Aroumd and Tamatert, or up to the Toubkal summit in two days.
imlil.alt: The village of Imlil with Riad Berber Towers in front of the High Atlas ridges
imlil.caption: Imlil and the Toubkal massif
